## 2. Service Offerings & Pricing Architecture

BizChefs maintains a transparent, milestone-based pricing model with zero hidden fees.

### 2.1 Website Design & Engineering
- **Starting Price**: $300 (Landing pages / focused business sites)
- **Typical Range**: $300 – $25,000+
- **Turnaround**: 1 to 8 weeks depending on scope
- **Payment Structure**: 50% deposit upon kickoff, 50% upon final staging sign-off before production domain launch.
- **Tiers**:
  1. **Starter Business Website ($300 – $800)**: Single-page or 3-page custom layout, Next.js 15 App Router, TypeScript, sub-second Core Web Vitals, WhatsApp integration, edge CDN deployment.
  2. **Multi-Page Commercial Platform ($1,000 – $3,500)**: Full catalog/service architecture, headless CMS or Markdown support, rate-limited lead capture pipeline, Schema.org JSON-LD, micro-animations, 100% client code ownership.
  3. **E-Commerce & Custom Booking Portal ($4,500 – $12,000)**: Stripe / Paymob checkout flows, user authentication, reservation calendars, automated transactional emails, administrative dashboards.
  4. **Custom Web Application / Enterprise ERP ($15,000 – $25,000+)**: Multi-tenant database partitioning (PostgreSQL / Supabase), role-based access control (RBAC), third-party ERP/CRM integrations, high-density tabular grids with sub-50ms sorting.

### 2.2 Monthly Website & Digital Care Retainers
- **Starting Price**: From $100 / month (or $83/mo billed annually - 17% savings)
- **Commitment**: Flexible monthly recurring. No lock-in contracts; cancel with 30 days notice.
- **Tiers**:
  1. **Essential Care ($100/mo / $83/mo annual)**: Weekly uptime monitoring, monthly dependency & security updates, offsite cloud backups, up to 1 hour of monthly content/technical changes, 48-hour SLA response.
  2. **Commercial Growth ($250/mo / $208/mo annual)**: 24/7 continuous uptime monitoring & alerts, bi-weekly security audits, daily database backups, up to 4 hours of monthly engineering/creative support, monthly Core Web Vitals tuning, priority 24-hour SLA.
  3. **Dedicated Retainer ($600+/mo / $500/mo annual)**: Real-time anomaly detection, weekly staging pipeline upgrades, continuous automated failover backups, up to 10 hours of active feature development, direct WhatsApp channel to senior engineering team, guaranteed 4-hour emergency SLA.

### 2.3 Graphic Design & Brand Identity
- **Scope**: Original vector logos, visual guidelines, typography palettes, and social media template suites.
- **Pricing**: Scoped from $500 (Brand Foundations) to $1,200 (Complete Brand Identity System) and $2,500+ (Multi-Channel Enterprise Brand Suite).
- **Deliverables**: 100% editable vector master source files (Figma, AI, SVG, EPS, PDF), trademark-ready copyright assignment.

### 2.4 Digital Strategy & Architecture Advisory
- **Discovery Session**: Complimentary exploratory consultation ($0) with a senior engineer.
- **Technical Blueprint Sprint**: $450 fixed-fee (100% credited toward your project build if you proceed with BizChefs).

## 4. Technical Stack & Engineering Standards

- **Runtime & Framework**: Node.js 20+, Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript
- **Styling Architecture**: Tailwind CSS v4, PostCSS, custom CSS variables for light/dark theme persistence
- **Animation**: `motion/react` for buttery 60fps route transitions and modal dialogs
- **Icons**: `lucide-react` (strictly no ad-hoc SVGs)
- **Forms & Anti-Spam**: Server-side rate-limited Next.js API Routes (`/api/contact`), in-memory IP sliding window, honeypot bot trap, structured JSON response with tracking reference IDs.
- **Security Hardening**:
  - Content Security Policy (CSP) headers
  - Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS), X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
  - PostCSS 8.5.23+ and postcss-selector-parser 7.1.6+ (zero CVE advisories)
  - No secret leaks: API keys server-only via `process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY`
- **PWA Capabilities**: Service Worker, Web App Manifest (`manifest.json`), install prompt handler, offline fallback indicator.
- **Accessibility**: WCAG 2.2 Level AA compliance, semantic HTML5, screen-reader landmarks, focus trapping on modals.

---

## 5. Regulatory Compliance & Data Protection

- **Egyptian Law No. 151 of 2020**: Full adherence to the Egyptian Personal Data Protection Law regarding lawful consent, purpose limitation, subject access requests, and cross-border data transfer safeguards.
- **European Union GDPR (Regulation EU 2016/679)**: Explicit consent before non-essential cookies, Google Consent Mode v2 implementation (`ad_storage: denied`, `analytics_storage: denied` until opt-in).
- **First-Party Storage Inventory**:
  - `bizchefs_cookie_consent_v1`: LocalStorage (Stores consent decision and timestamp)
  - `bizchefs_theme`: LocalStorage (Theme preference dark/light)
  - `pwa_prompt_dismissed_until`: LocalStorage (14-day suppression)
  - `bizchefs_plan_config_draft`: SessionStorage (Caches user tier selection during session)
  - `_ga`, `_ga_*`: HTTP Cookies (Google Analytics 4, only activated upon opt-in consent)
